claim_boundary: Source-linked counter semantics and justified counter distinctions; no dynamic calibration, runtime coverage percentage, or completeness claim.

counters.meaning: Pairs materialized by one match-edge expansion, classified by local/hinted/full-scan path; candidates may later fail bound checks.
counters.name: candidate_pairs_enumerated

counters.meaning: One increment per pair entering the extend_each candidate loop, before bound-source/target rejection.
counters.name: candidate_tests

counters.meaning: Subset of candidate-loop iterations rejected by already-bound endpoint equality checks.
counters.name: bound_rejections

counters.equation: where_evaluations = interpreted/JIT whole-where and remaining-conjunct evaluations
counters.meaning: Calls to a where expression or an unpruned conjunct, counted after boolean evaluation; pushdown evaluations use a separate counter.
counters.name: where_evaluations

counters.equation: leaf_visits = successful match leaves reaching the visitor
counters.meaning: A match leaf after distinct-variable and where checks; cloned-binding counts are recorded on the cold-path consumer, not as a general matcher identity count.
counters.name: successful_bindings

counters.meaning: Monolithic run_rules scheduler slot counts: external poll, fixed-point probe, dirty-vector scan, and selected-rule count. Work events are emitted outside RuleUID attribution.
counters.name: scheduler_work
not_equivalent_to: all scheduler work in the process

counters.equation: enqueue_total and drained_item_total are separate; equality is not guaranteed across pending queues or early exits
counters.meaning: Recognized enqueue counts and between-pass drain batches/items; drained items include stale or rejected records.
counters.name: deferred_queue_work

counters.equation: no exact equation to candidate_tests; candidate rejects and failed edge identities are not represented by successful pattern_edge rows
counters.meaning: Selected access/effect rows with concrete graph identities; successful match-edge rows occur only after a complete successful binding.
counters.name: concrete_access_events

counters.equation: requires an explicit host-side invocation/result counter; no equation is available from native access rows alone
counters.meaning: UseTool dispatch crosses into a registered Python callback; callback reads, writes, and external effects are not native concrete graph-access events.
counters.name: host_callback_work

next_dynamic_gate: Use controlled graphs with independently known candidate, where, binding, scheduler-slot, queue, and callback counts; verify each counter separately, include negative/no-op/rejected controls, and capture uninstrumented semantic parity. Keep host/scheduler totals outside RuleUID traces.
uncovered_cost_classes: adapter/boot work outside the captured run_rules operation
failed matcher identities and rejected-edge dependencies
some specialized Term scans and helper-mediated graph reads
post-rule effects without a recognized deferred-queue hook
